rng_sources.name: Kernel
rng_sources.origin: Bare Array#sample in opportunity_factories.rb:10 and lead_factories.rb:19; RSpec seed orders examples but this app does not call srand. Natural off-only and diagnostic seeded off-only traces prove random-dependent SQL branches.

rng_sources.name: FFaker::Random
rng_sources.origin: FFaker 2.25.0 has its own Random, independent of Kernel; factory names/emails and other generated attributes consume it. Identical per-example Kernel/FFaker seeds remove the proved branches in off/off/on/on diagnostics.

sql_entries.origin: Bare Array#sample in spec/factories/opportunity_factories.rb:10 uses the Kernel RNG, unseeded by RSpec --seed (which only orders examples). OpportunityObserver#after_create at app/models/observers/opportunity_observer.rb:14 adds a campaign-revenue UPDATE only for stage == won. FFaker has a separate RNG; neither source is seeded by this app.
